🥺Dadan and Ace shared one of the most emotional and underrated relationships in One Piece. Although Dadan constantly scolded Ace, hit him, and acted tough, every harsh word hid the love of a mother who cared deeply for him. After Garp left Ace in her care, she raised him alongside Luffy, feeding them, protecting them, and giving them a place they could call home. Ace never openly expressed his gratitude, but Dadan's home was the first place where he truly found a family. She watched him grow from a lonely, angry child who hated his own existence into a strong young man who found people worth living for. When Ace died at Marineford, Dadan's grief showed just how much he meant to her. She broke down in tears, screamed in pain, and even punched Garp because she couldn't bear the loss of the [...] .  
.  
#dadan #ace #broken #onepiece #luffy [...] even punched Garp because she couldn't bear the loss of the boy she had raised. In that heartbreaking moment, it became clear that Ace was never just someone she looked after—he was her son in every way that mattered. Their relationship proved that family isn't defined by blood, but by love, sacrifice, and the people who stay by your side when no one else will. Even though Ace became one of the world's greatest pirates, to Dadan he would always be the stubborn little boy she loved with all her heart.
